name: A Message in Blood
summary: Krom’rosh sends you against the human farm at Meadowsbrook. He wants the farmhands slain to answer the defectors’ claim to the land.

sections.title: The Farmhands
sections.body: Krom’rosh points you toward Meadowsbrook Farm, southwest across the river. Human defectors claimed the farm some years ago, then reached toward Farholde, the keep on the eastern shore. Krom’rosh says earlier skirmishes lacked the numbers to prevail. Now he wants you to disrupt the farm and leave no prisoners.

faq.q: Who asks me to go to Meadowsbrook?
faq.answer: Krom’rosh asks you to attack Meadowsbrook Farm and disrupt its farming.

faq.q: Why does Krom’rosh want the farm attacked?
faq.answer: Human defectors claimed the farm and expanded toward Farholde. Krom’rosh wants to remind them his people are present.
Meadowsbrook Farm lies southwest across the river.
The Meadowsbrook Farmhands are the people Krom’rosh sends you to slay.

faq.q: What happened in the earlier skirmishes?
faq.answer: Krom’rosh says the earlier skirmishes would have favored his side if they had had more fighters.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you carry out Krom’rosh’s order against human defectors who have claimed the farm.
